Container.Name: Ratatoskr
Container.Overview:
Ratatoskr is a self-hosted webmail client for any IMAP/SMTP account. One container, configured by environment variables, with data in SQLite under /data. Features: unified inbox, conversations, Web Push notifications and PWA, snooze, and dark mode. Every email is treated as hostile: server-side sanitising, sandboxed rendering, and remote images are proxied.
REQUIRES HTTPS through a reverse proxy (SWAG, Nginx Proxy Manager, Traefik, Caddy) for push notifications and installing it as an app. WebSockets on /api/ws must be proxied. Set the Base URL to the public https address and keep Trust Proxy enabled.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Web interface port.

Config.Name: AppData
Config.Description: Holds ratatoskr.db (users, accounts, settings) and cache.db (mail cache).

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID the server runs as and that owns /data. The entrypoint chowns /data and drops privileges. Image default is 1000; Unraid uses 99.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID the server runs as and that owns /data. Image default is 1000; Unraid uses 100.

Config.Name: UMASK
Config.Description: Optional umask for files the server creates, e.g. 022.

Config.Name: Base URL
Config.Description: Public https URL users reach Ratatoskr at, e.g. https://mail.example.com. Used for the OIDC redirect URI, the cookie Secure flag and the WebSocket origin check.

Config.Name: Secret Key
Config.Description: Master secret, at least 32 characters. Generate one with: openssl rand -base64 48. WARNING: changing it later makes stored mail account passwords unreadable.

Config.Name: Trust Proxy
Config.Description: Trust X-Forwarded-* headers. Keep true when running behind a reverse proxy.

Config.Name: Password Login
Config.Description: Optional. Enable username/password login (true/false). Leave empty for the default: true without OIDC, false with OIDC.

Config.Name: Registration
Config.Description: Who may create a password account: open, first (first user of an empty instance only) or closed.

Config.Name: OIDC Issuer URL
Config.Description: Optional OIDC. Issuer URL; the discovery document is read from it. Register ${RATATOSKR_BASE_URL}/auth/callback as the redirect URI with your provider.

Config.Name: OIDC Client ID
Config.Description: Optional OIDC client ID.

Config.Name: OIDC Client Secret
Config.Description: Optional OIDC client secret (confidential clients).

Config.Name: OIDC Label
Config.Description: Optional. Provider name shown on the login button. Empty uses the default (Single sign-on).

Config.Name: OIDC Scopes
Config.Description: Scopes requested from the OIDC provider.

Config.Name: Block Private Mail Hosts
Config.Description: Refuse IMAP/SMTP hosts resolving to private/internal addresses. Leave false when your mail server is on the LAN.

Config.Name: Default IMAP Host
Config.Description: Optional. Pre-fills the IMAP host in the Add account form. Accepts {username}, {email} and {name} tokens.

Config.Name: Default SMTP Host
Config.Description: Optional. Pre-fills the SMTP host in the Add account form. Accepts {username}, {email} and {name} tokens.

Config.Name: Default IMAP Security
Config.Description: Optional. tls, starttls or none (app default: tls).

Config.Name: Default SMTP Security
Config.Description: Optional. tls, starttls or none (app default: tls).

Config.Name: Default IMAP Port
Config.Description: Optional. Pre-fills the IMAP port. Accepts the {username}, {email} and {name} tokens.

Config.Name: Default SMTP Port
Config.Description: Optional. Pre-fills the SMTP port. Accepts the {username}, {email} and {name} tokens.

Config.Name: Default Mail Username
Config.Description: Optional. Pre-fills the mail username. Accepts {username}, {email} and {name} tokens.

Config.Name: Default Email
Config.Description: Optional. Pre-fills the email address, e.g. {username}@example.com. Accepts {username}, {email} and {name} tokens.

Config.Name: Default Display Name
Config.Description: Optional. Pre-fills the sender display name. Accepts {username}, {email} and {name} tokens.

Config.Name: Default Account Label
Config.Description: Optional. Pre-fills the account label. Accepts {username}, {email} and {name} tokens.

Config.Name: Cache
Config.Description: Keep a local copy of each account's newest INBOX and Sent mail. false always asks the mail server.

Config.Name: Cache Messages
Config.Description: Newest messages kept per cached folder (50-100000).

Config.Name: Cache Max Body MB
Config.Description: Largest message whose content is cached. 0 keeps no message content.

Config.Name: Cache Account MB
Config.Description: Message content kept per account; least recently read is removed first.

Config.Name: Max Message MB
Config.Description: Largest message the server downloads for display.

Config.Name: Max Upload MB
Config.Description: Largest total attachment upload when composing.

Config.Name: IMAP Idle Timeout
Config.Description: Seconds before an unused pooled IMAP connection is closed.

Config.Name: VAPID Subject
Config.Description: Optional. Contact sent to push services. Empty uses the base URL if https, else mailto:postmaster@host.

Config.Name: Log Level
Config.Description: One of fatal, error, warn, info, debug, trace.
